name: What Is a Capability
title: What Is a Capability
description: A capability is the ability to reliably produce an outcome: the tools, skills, processes, and suppliers together. Owning a tool is not a capability; producing good parts with it repeatedly is.
how_it_works: Define capabilities as outcome-abilities ('machine aluminum to +/-0.05mm repeatedly'), not asset lists. Test each claimed capability with evidence of past performance.

standards: Capability maturity and assessment practice; skills gap analysis methods.
